title: refactor(ci): split lint/test/release workflows, improve cache and hygiene
author: Priya Nambiar
description:
Motivation: Our monolithic CI workflow has become fragile and slow -- lint, unit tests, integration tests, and release automation were all in one large workflow. This leads to wasted runner time, difficult caching strategies, and brittle reruns when individual stages fail. This PR splits the workflows into focused pipelines (lint, test, release) and applies a few hygiene and cache improvements to reduce overall runtime and flakiness.

What this PR does: 
- Split the previous .github/workflows/ci.yml into: .github/workflows/lint.yml, .github/workflows/test.yml, .github/workflows/release.yml.
- Introduce a shared cache helper (scripts/ci/cache-utils.sh) for actions/cache key generation and pruning.
- Pin and bump critical GitHub Actions to stable versions (actions/checkout@v4, actions/setup-node@v4, actions/cache@v4) and move long-running build/test jobs to self-hosted runners where available.
- Add a lightweight fast-lint job that runs on PRs and a full lint job that runs on push to main to reduce feedback loop for contributors.
- Improve test matrix to separate unit vs integration, and gate expensive integration tests to a schedule or release-tag path.
- Clean up legacy Node 16 references in Docker CI images and update docs/ci.md.

Checklist:
- [x] Split workflows and add documentation update (docs/ci.md).
- [x] Verify cache hit rate locally and on CI for the lint/test pipelines.
- [x] Smoke-run release workflow in a dry-run (no publish).
- [x] Update contributing guide with new CI expectations.

Notes and links: linear/ENG-4321 contains the design discussion and performance targets. Related PRs: pr-183456 (previous attempt to split), pr-196753 (cache hygiene). This is intentionally conservative: no behavioral changes to tests or releases, only orchestration and dependency hygiene.

CI behavior during PR: initial run had two flaky integration failures (transient timeouts); fixed by isolating integration jobs and adding a retry wrapper. Final CI run: all required checks passed and release workflow executed a dry-run.

Merge: Squash merge after approvals. See release_notes for user-facing changes.
commits: consolidate: split ci.yml into lint.yml, test.yml, release.yml
ci: add scripts/ci/cache-utils.sh and cache key strategy
chore: bump actions/checkout and setup-node versions
fix(ci): add retry wrapper for flaky integration job
review_comments: Ethan Morales: Can we avoid Node 16 in any job? Some infra still references node:16 in docker/ci.Dockerfile. Action: updated Dockerfile to node 20 and left a comment about legacy images.
Lina Chen: The cache keys were colliding on matrix builds; can you namespace by job? Action: added job-specific prefix in scripts/ci/cache-utils.sh and increased cache-version counter.

Marco Alvarez: Suggest gating expensive integration tests to schedule or release tag to save runner credits. Action: moved integration tests behind 'if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' || startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/tags/') || github.event_name == 'schedule''.
Priya Nambiar (author): addressed feedback, added comments and tests for cache key generation, and confirmed green CI after retries.
release_notes: Split CI workflows for faster PR feedback: fast-lint on PRs, full lint on push; separate unit and integration test pipelines; improved caching strategy and updated GitHub Action versions. No user-facing behavior changes.
